A '''clone trooper captain''' accompanied [[Junior Representative/Legends|Representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] on a [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomatic]] mission during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Frozen Out!" />

==Biography==
Following the [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomatic]] negotiations, the [[Clone Captain/Legends|clone trooper captain]] accompanied Kenobi and Binks back to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. En route, their [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was attacked by a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]], and they crash-landed on the ice [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. The [[Captain/Legends|captain]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the ensuing [[Skirmish on Hoth|skirmish]].<ref name="Frozen Out!" />
